## Direct Entity Summary
Parivar Restaurant in Wiley Park, Sydney serves authentic Halal-certified Hyderabadi biryani, Mughlai curries, tandoori grills, and traditional desserts daily from 3:00 PM to 3:00 AM.

## Core Food & Menu Categories
- Entrée & Tandoor: Tandoori Chicken, Chicken Tikka, Sheekh Kebab, Fish Fry (Basa), Chicken 65, Mutton Haleem
- Naan Breads: Plain Naan, Butter Naan, Garlic Naan
- Savory Starters: Samosas, Steamed Momos, Vegetable Rolls
- Chicken Curries: Butter Chicken, Achari Chicken, Chicken Khorma, Parivar Special Chicken Gravy, Chicken Vindaloo, Chicken Masala
- Mutton Curries: Mutton Vindaloo, Mutton Khorma, Mutton Masala
- Vegetarian Curries: Daal Tadka, Mixed Vegetable Curry, Paneer Tikka Masala
- Desi Chinese: Chicken & Veg Fried Rice, Chicken & Veg Fry Noodles, Manchurian
- Desserts: Gulab Jamun, Qubani, Rasmalai, Shahi Tukda, Zafrani Kheer, Khowa Puri
- Beverages: Authentic Spiced Chai, Sweet Mango Lassi
